findings.reproduction: Transfer meme token to a generated recipient, then look up recipient public address in Explorer.
findings.observed: Recipient shows 0 TEST and No account allocated because the wallet's system account is unallocated; associated token holdings are not shown. The public API confirms the recipient associated token account holds 1 PILOTONE.
findings.impact: A first-time tester cannot verify received meme-token holdings through the recipient wallet address view. Existing limited explorer wording is accurate, so this is not recorded as a failed chain action.
findings.suggestion: Later add token holdings for wallet lookups or a clear link to the recipient associated token account.

findings.observed: Notice says Confirmed. Final ownership verification is separate., while issuance remains verified. The wording refers to ownership generically even for a fungible meme-token transfer.
findings.suggestion: Later use balance-verification wording for meme-token transfer.

limitations: Agent pilot substitutes only as explicitly selected by founder; no independent human test was performed.
No NFT issuance, NFT transfer, native TEST transfer, faucet retry, invalid-input suite or user-wallet connection in this pilot.
Mobile checks cover Explorer only; no mobile transaction submission.
Single browser engine; no assistive technology test beyond observed accessibility tree and one keyboard form-submission path.
Supplemental read-only public RPC checks used Python urllib after sandbox DNS access failed; all state-changing transactions were exercised through the public browser UI.
No app source, test source or cloud configuration changed.
